description: Writes the formal PR-review deliverable: a standards-cited findings register (Blocker/Question/Major/Nit) with PR comments for senior developers, a scoped approval, and promotion-manifest checks for environment-branch promotions. Grades Android, iOS, Spring Boot, React/Next.js and generic repos. Use when asked to "review this PR", "review the promotion", "formal PR review", "write up a review we can post" or "re-review the PR", even without naming this skill. Not the built-in /code-review, which gives quick inline findings on a working tree.
